post.description: Confirms that a delivered publish payload was applied at the destination (used by the Temso Zapier app's Confirm publication action). Drives the publication to succeeded and records the external post. Replays with the same idempotency key are no-ops.

externalId.description: The destination's ID for the created/updated post.

externalUrl.description: Public URL of the post at the destination.

idempotencyKey.description: Receiver-chosen key (e.g. the created post ID). Replays with the same key are no-ops.

publicationId.description: The publicationId from the delivered payload.

remoteState.description: State the destination applied: draft or published.

get.description: Returns recent article publishes rendered as contract v1 payload samples (used by the Temso Zapier app so fields can be mapped in the Zap editor without a real publish). Falls back to a static sample when the project has no publishes yet.

data.description: Contract v1 publish payloads, newest first, each with a unique publicationId.

post.description: Subscribes a webhook URL to article publishes in a project (used by the Temso Zapier app when a Zap is turned on). Publish payloads are POSTed to the URL as contract v1. Returns the subscription ID needed to unsubscribe.

targetUrl.description: The URL Temso POSTs publish payloads to (e.g. the Zapier-generated hook URL).

id.description: Subscription ID. Pass it to the unsubscribe endpoint.

delete.description: Removes a publish subscription (used by the Temso Zapier app when a Zap is turned off). Publish payloads stop being delivered to the subscribed URL.

post.description: Accepts batches of request events (1–500 per call) from a Cloudflare Worker installed at your edge, used by the Temso traffic integration to attribute AI-driven visits. Requires an API key with the traffic:ingest scope; the worker generated during setup calls this endpoint for you — you don't need to call it when consuming the API.

schema.description: The traffic source ID assigned during setup

asn.description: Autonomous system number of the client network, null when unknown

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the client, null when unknown

ip.description: Raw client IP. Hashed and prefix-anonymized server-side, then discarded.

referer.description: Referer header of the request, null when absent

status.description: HTTP status code returned to the client

ts.description: Unix milliseconds when the request was observed at the edge

timestamp.description: Unix milliseconds when the batch was sent. Used for idempotent retries.

accepted.description: Number of events stored from this batch.

dropped.description: Number of events rejected (malformed or filtered).

idempotent.description: True when the batch was already processed and skipped.

revoked.description: True when the traffic source has been revoked; stop sending events.

get.description: Projects this API key can publish to, used by the Temso Zapier app to validate the connection and populate the project dropdown. Requires the content:publish scope.
